headerDisplay: Controls Danalock V3 locks through the Danalock cloud API. **A Danabridge is required** — the V3-BT is Bluetooth-only and the Danabridge is what puts it on the network.
footerDisplay: Commands take roughly 5-7 seconds (cloud → Danabridge → Bluetooth → lock). Locking/unlocking from HomeKit updates immediately on success; the poll interval only controls how quickly *externally* made changes (physical key, Danalock app, auto-lock) are noticed.

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform name shown in the Homebridge log.

username.title: Danalock Account Email
username.description: The email address of your Danalock account.

password.title: Danalock Account Password
password.description: Stored in your Homebridge config. Never logged.

pollInterval.title: State Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Gap between state-refresh rounds. Controls how quickly changes made outside HomeKit are noticed. Each read costs a 5-7s round-trip to the lock, so values below 5s are clamped and will only cause 'bridge busy' errors. Shorter intervals also keep the Danabridge busier, so a lock/unlock you trigger is more likely to queue behind a poll before it runs.

batteryPollInterval.title: Battery Poll Interval (seconds)
batteryPollInterval.description: How often to read the battery level. Battery changes slowly and each read costs a full round-trip to the lock, so this should stay much higher than the state poll interval.

showBattery.title: Show Battery Level
showBattery.description: Expose the lock's battery level in HomeKit. It appears within the lock accessory (not as a separate tile) and drives the Low Battery warning.

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low Battery Threshold (%)
lowBatteryThreshold.description: Battery percentage at or below which HomeKit shows a Low Battery warning.

unresponsiveThreshold.title: Unresponsive Threshold (failed polls)
unresponsiveThreshold.description: How many consecutive failed state polls before the lock shows as 'No Response' in the Home app. A lock is not shown as Locked/Unlocked once its state can no longer be verified. Increase this if you are on flaky Wi-Fi and prefer more tolerance.

locks.title: Lock Filter
locks.description: Optional. Leave empty to expose every lock on the account.

identifier.title: Lock Name or Serial
identifier.description: The lock's name as shown in the Danalock app, or its serial number.

exclude.title: Exclude this lock
exclude.description: If any entry is left un-excluded, only the listed locks are exposed. Excluded locks are always hidden.
